title: I've been building a Saas startup for retail traders for the past 3 months. Now it's time to launch 🚀
author: Youknowbetterkid
selftext:
Hi everyone 😊, I'm Dylan, the founder of trumpsignaltracker (TST). I built trumpsignaltracker to simplify a part of my strategy that made me over $6000 with 400% returns. I have always been interested in stocks and trading, and have been investing since 2019.  I started my trading journey back in March 2024 by researching everything there is to know about options trading, then began paper trading while exploring strategies like earnings plays and buying rumours and selling the news, which led me to the strategy that worked for me.

One thing I struggled with most was being in a time zone more than 14 hours behind, without real-time access to information or the ability to act on it to plan entries and exits for option plays hastily.

With TST, you can,

* Track Donald Trump’s social media posts on X and Truth Social for alerts via email, Discord, or Telegram, and even filter for only keywords
* Get transcriptions for any videos he posts
* AI insights linking any mention of CEOs of companies within a post with context
* Automatically classifies any AI slop he posts, so you can get the real data

New users are given 10 minutes free before they are prompted to pay for the PRO plan. If you do end up paying for the plan and don’t want to continue your subscription, you can email [support@trumpsignaltracker.com](mailto:support@trumpsignaltracker.com) with a reason for cancellation (ideally detailed), and I will issue a 100% refund if your account is less than a day old. I’m looking for feedback to help improve my platform so I can ultimately provide a valuable tool that empowers retail traders to give them an edge. I highly recommend checking it out, even if it's just for inspiration for trading ideas.

My startup link: [trumpsignaltracker.com](http://trumpsignaltracker.com/)

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body:
Solid niche, and the time-zone problem you described is a real gap for retail traders. Some feedback:

* **Show the outcome, not just the alert.** For each post, log the price reaction of the mentioned tickers at 1 min, 15 min and 1 hour, and whether the move held. Traders will trust the tool much more if they can see which post types moved markets and which were noise.
* **Timestamps and latency.** Make it clear how long after posting the alert fires. On post-driven moves, the first minutes carry most of the move, so alert delay should be measured and displayed.
* **Base rates.** Show how often a given kind of post (tariffs, a named CEO, a specific sector) led to a tradable move, so users can filter accordingly.
* **Overlap with scheduled events.** Posts landing near an earnings release or a CPI print mix two catalysts, so tag them.

That last point is where structured event data helps. It's what we build at Cymetica with EventTrader, timestamped scheduled events you could join against post times to separate the two effects.

Good luck with the launch.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: ten minutes is the wrong unit for a trial on this. the value of a post tracker shows up on the days he posts something that moves a name, which might be zero times in any given ten minutes. measure the trial in events, say the first three alerts are free, and the person decides after seeing what an alert looks like against the tape. and the returns line in the intro will get you dismissed by exactly the traders you want, drop it from the pitch.

replies.author: Youknowbetterkid
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback. I am thinking of implementing many of these features, but I am looking for more feedback for my website which I have removed the 10 minute limit for free plans.
